title.narrative: Social and Economic Cohesion through Vocational Education - II

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Action is to support the transition of the most vulnerable ESSN beneficiaries to a self-reliant life in the host communities by improving their employability and qualifications. In order to ensure social cohesion among the final beneficiary groups, other refugees and host communities will be included to the Action
